statement: Terminal Quest landing uses one immutable review envelope that binds sealed landing evidence, the additive required verification-template union, deterministic generated test-manifest receipts, content-keyed pure-proof receipts, and source epoch; structured verifier verdict files are validated and ingested without duplicating fingerprint or finding entry, while default operator output is concise and verbose or JSON output remains complete.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The implementation preserves start, continue, and land as the only primary operator verbs and places review-envelope preparation and verdict ingestion inside land.
doneWhen remains the sealed product success predicate; reviewReady and landReady requirements may gate review or commit but never redefine SOLVED.
The candidate review checklist is the additive union of sealed verificationTemplates and mechanically applicable templates and can never narrow the sealed bar.

Generated dependency and reusable proof receipts are derived from exact candidate inputs; PASS reuse is limited to an allowlisted deterministic proof registry and never covers live, timing, mutation, red-on-revert, random, network, or host-state evidence.

Verifier verdict files are bounded regular workspace files containing canonical plain JSON data; the review owns fingerprint, scope, and paths, and every required template is accounted for before a verdict can be recorded.
